name: Guinea
description: Guinea from the Mali Empire and the Fouta Djallon to French rule, the "no" of 1958, Sékou Touré and the coups of today.

checkpoints.name: Kingdoms and imams
checkpoints.note: Guinea's north was part of the Mali Empire. The imams of Fouta Djallon ruled the highlands, and Samori Touré built an empire.

checkpoints.name: French Guinea
checkpoints.note: France made Guinea a colony in 1891 and defeated Samori in 1898.

checkpoints.name: Independent Guinea
checkpoints.note: Guinea voted no to France in 1958 and became independent. Sékou Touré ruled for 26 years, followed by soldiers and an Ebola epidemic.
